l4_steps.name: Execute metasearch partner agreement & API onboarding
l4_steps.input: Signed commercial agreement with metasearch partner (Google Flights, Kayak, Skyscanner)
l4_steps.output: API credentials, endpoint URLs, CPC rate card
l4_steps.kpi: Partner onboarding lead time ≤30 days from contract signature
l4_steps.pain_point: Each metasearch partner requires bespoke API configurations; NDC schema versioning mismatches between partners cause silent feed failures with no error surfaced to airline

l4_steps.name: Configure fare & schedule feed for metasearch ingestion
l4_steps.input: API credentials, ATPCO fare filing rules, schedule data from Amadeus SkyWORKS
l4_steps.output: Configured fare feed in OTA Schema or NDC 21.3 format
l4_steps.kpi: Feed configuration accuracy ≥99% (zero critical field mappings missing)
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO filing propagation latency (up to 24h) means published fares lag dynamic pricing changes in Amadeus NRM, creating an arbitrage window exploited by OTAs

l4_steps.name: Validate feed quality & schema compliance
l4_steps.system: NDC API Gateway / Postman API Testing Suite
l4_steps.input: Test feed response from metasearch sandbox environment
l4_steps.output: Validation report; go/no-go decision for production activation
l4_steps.kpi: Zero critical schema errors before go-live; feed round-trip response ≤2s (p95)
l4_steps.pain_point: NDC 21.3 vs 17.2 schema incompatibility across metasearch partners; several comparison sites (Momondo, Kayak) accept only legacy EDIFACT/GDS feeds, forcing dual-channel maintenance

l4_steps.name: Publish fare cache to metasearch price index
l4_steps.input: Current fare inventory from Amadeus Altéa PSS booking class availability
l4_steps.output: Fare cache updated on metasearch price index
l4_steps.kpi: Fare cache refresh latency ≤15 minutes; stale fare rate <2%
l4_steps.pain_point: Fare cache staleness causes price disparity between metasearch display price and booking engine checkout; leads to consumer complaints and potential EU261/ATPCO fare filing violations

l4_steps.name: Sync real-time seat availability via NDC/GDS
l4_steps.input: Live inventory status from Altéa booking classes (Y, B, M, H, Q, etc.)
l4_steps.output: Real-time availability displayed on metasearch for each fare bucket
l4_steps.kpi: Availability accuracy ≥98.5% vs Altéa live booking class status
l4_steps.pain_point: GDS RBD (Reservation Booking Designator) mapping inconsistencies between Altéa and Sabre GDS cause availability discrepancies; sold-out fare classes displayed as available on Skyscanner, generating 'sorry, fare unavailable' errors at checkout

l4_steps.name: Perform fare parity audit across distribution channels
l4_steps.input: Published fares scraped from metasearch, GDS, and airline.com for same O&D/date
l4_steps.output: Fare parity compliance report; exception list of breached routes
l4_steps.kpi: Fare parity compliance ≥95% across monitored routes; exception resolution ≤4 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Dynamic pricing adjustments in Amadeus NRM create unintentional fare disparities across channels; corporate/negotiated fares inadvertently surfaced on public metasearch breach TMC contract confidentiality clauses

l4_steps.name: Define CPC bid strategy by route and market segment
l4_steps.system: Google Flights Hotel Ads Console / Kayak Partner Portal
l4_steps.input: Historical CTR data, route revenue targets from Amadeus NRM, seasonal demand forecast
l4_steps.output: CPC bid schedule per route, date range, and cabin class
l4_steps.kpi: Target CPC ≤$0.45 domestic routes; ≤$1.20 international routes
l4_steps.pain_point: Metasearch auction dynamics require continuous bid optimisation; static bid tables lose price competitiveness within hours during peak booking windows (holiday periods, fare sales)

l4_steps.name: Monitor click-through rates and impression share
l4_steps.system: Google Flights Ads Console / AWS Redshift
l4_steps.input: Live metasearch impression and click data feed from partner APIs
l4_steps.output: Daily CTR dashboard; impression share report by route
l4_steps.kpi: CTR ≥1.8% on primary routes; impression share ≥40% for top 20 O&D markets
l4_steps.pain_point: Metasearch partner APIs throttle reporting data refresh to 6-hour intervals; bid adjustments based on stale data reduce campaign ROI during intraday demand spikes

l4_steps.name: Adjust bids using demand signals and competitor fares
l4_steps.system: Google Flights Ads Console / PROS RM
l4_steps.input: Competitor fare monitoring signals, demand forecast from Amadeus SkyCAST
l4_steps.output: Updated bid schedule; exception report for routes with bid floor violations
l4_steps.kpi: ROAS (return on ad spend) ≥4.5x on metasearch channel; bid update turnaround ≤2 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: PROS RM demand signals are not natively integrated with Google Flights bid management console; manual data transfer introduces 24-hour lag, blunting competitive responsiveness

l4_steps.name: Generate deep-link redirect URL to booking engine
l4_steps.system: NDC API Gateway / Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Metasearch user click event with fare parameters (O&D, date, cabin class, fare basis)
l4_steps.output: Deep-link URL to airline booking engine pre-populated with selected itinerary
l4_steps.pain_point: Session parameter passing between metasearch redirect and booking engine breaks on Safari/iOS mobile browsers due to ITP cookie restrictions; causes booking abandonment rate >35% on mobile

l4_steps.name: Track metasearch click-to-confirmed-booking conversion
l4_steps.input: Click event from metasearch partner; booking confirmation event from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Conversion rate report per metasearch partner, route, and device type
l4_steps.pain_point: Cross-domain tracking gaps between metasearch redirect and airline.com booking funnel cause 20–30% attribution loss; inflates apparent cost-per-booking and understates true metasearch channel value

l4_steps.name: Aggregate metasearch channel performance data
l4_steps.input: Click, impression, conversion, and revenue data from all metasearch partner APIs
l4_steps.output: Consolidated metasearch performance dashboard covering all partners
l4_steps.kpi: Data pipeline freshness ≤4 hours; dashboard availability ≥99.5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Each metasearch partner (Google Flights, Kayak, Skyscanner, Momondo) exposes proprietary reporting APIs with incompatible schemas; ETL pipeline maintenance requires dedicated engineering resource

l4_steps.name: Calculate cost-per-booking and channel contribution margin
l4_steps.input: Metasearch ad spend from CPC invoices; booking revenue from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Channel P&L report; cost-per-booking by partner and route
l4_steps.pain_point: Attribution of ancillary revenue (checked bags, seat upgrades, travel insurance) to the originating metasearch channel is inconsistent across reporting systems, systematically understating true channel margin contribution

l4_steps.name: Reconcile metasearch partner click invoices vs tracked clicks
l4_steps.input: Monthly CPC invoice from metasearch partner; internal click tracking logs from AWS Redshift
l4_steps.output: Reconciliation report; dispute list for unmatched or bot-classified clicks
l4_steps.kpi: Invoice match rate ≥97%; dispute raised within 10 business days of invoice receipt
l4_steps.pain_point: Discrepancies between partner-reported clicks and airline-side tracking arise from differing bot/invalid-traffic filtering rules; Google Flights click audit process takes 45–90 days, creating cash flow exposure on disputed amounts

l4_steps.name: Raise formal dispute with metasearch partner for excess clicks
l4_steps.input: Reconciliation exception list; internal click evidence from AWS Redshift logs
l4_steps.output: Formal dispute submission; credit note or adjusted invoice from partner
l4_steps.kpi: Dispute resolution ≤30 days; credit recovery rate ≥90% of disputed amount
l4_steps.pain_point: Absence of a neutral click audit standard across metasearch platforms means dispute outcomes depend on partner goodwill; airlines with low traffic volume have limited negotiating leverage

l4_steps.name: Process approved metasearch invoices for payment
l4_steps.input: Approved reconciliation report; vendor invoice cleared of disputes
l4_steps.output: Payment instruction executed in SAP; cleared invoice posted to GL
l4_steps.kpi: Payment processed within contract terms (Net 30/Net 45); zero late payment penalties
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-currency CPC invoices (USD, EUR, GBP) require FX rate alignment between SAP FI and partner billing systems; rate discrepancies >0.5% trigger re-approval workflows, delaying payment and risking vendor relationship
